```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

smaller <- diamonds %>% 
  filter(carat <= 2.5)
```

We have data about `r nrow(diamonds)` diamonds. Only 
`r nrow(diamonds) - nrow(smaller)` are larger than 
2.5 carats. The distributuon of the remainder is shown below:

```{r, echo = FALSE}
smaller %>% 
  ggplot(aes(carat)) +
  geom_freqpoly(binwidth = 0.01)
```
